roster.createTip: Create a raid roster from this Kader

createTipSub.one: {count} player comes along: Roster → Core, Bench → Bench, Tentative → Trial. Interviews, answers, votes and comments stay in the planner.
createTipSub.other: {count} players come along: Roster → Core, Bench → Bench, Tentative → Trial. Interviews, answers, votes and comments stay in the planner.

roster.createTitle: Create a roster from the Kader
roster.createHint: Only the status and the decided character come along. Afterwards everything is editable in the roster – name, members, status, roles.
roster.categoryHint: With a category, reminders, "missing" lists and the setup proposal use this roster. It can be changed in the roster later.
roster.syncTip: Take newly decided players into the roster
roster.syncTipSub: Whoever is in the roster already stays as they are. Only status and character come along.

syncText.one: {count} player joins the roster and gets the roster role. Whoever is in it already stays as they are.
syncText.other: {count} players join the roster and get the roster role. Whoever is in it already stays as they are.

roleFailures.one: The role could not be given to {count} player.
roleFailures.other: The role could not be given to {count} players.

openTipSub.one: {count} member. Name, members, status and roles are edited there.
openTipSub.other: {count} members. Name, members, status and roles are edited there.

error.category_taken: This category already has a roster.
error.name_too_long: The name is too long (40 characters at most).
error.kader_taken: This roster is already linked to another Kader.
error.kader_taken_over: The Kader has already been taken over to Discord – the roster stays linked.
error.version_mismatch: This roster or category plays another game version than the Kader.
error.version_hidden: This Kader's game version is hidden.

roster.linkTip: Link this Kader to a roster that already exists
roster.linkTipSub: “Take into the roster” then goes into exactly this roster.
roster.linkTipSuggestion: Suggestion: {name} – its category counts in this Kader's attendance.
roster.linkHint: Nothing is copied. Afterwards “Take into the roster” takes newly decided players into exactly this roster. A Kader belongs to one roster at most.
roster.linkPickHint: Suggested is the roster whose raid category counts in this Kader's attendance.
roster.linkCountCategory: Count this category's attendance in the Kader
roster.linkCountCategoryTip: Adds the roster's raid category to this Kader's attendance (Kader settings).
roster.unlinkText: The roster stays as it is, with all its members. Only “Take into the roster” no longer goes there.

start.kicker: Roster planner · the steps of a squad
start.title: From Discord to the roster
start.readOnly: There is no squad yet. Whoever may edit the roster planner can create one.

import.title: Pick a Discord role
import.what: Everybody with the role shows up, characters prefilled from profiles and logs.

pool.title: Pool
pool.what: Everybody taken into this squad; one switch per player puts them into the preselection.

selected.title: Preselection · Interviews
selected.what: Talk to everybody: their wishes in order and this squad's questions.

overview.title: Preselection · Overview
overview.what: Everybody's wishes and answers side by side: filter, compare, choose.

provisional.title: Provisional roster
provisional.what: The leads discuss: votes, comments and example setups (10 or 20).

roster.title: Roster · Bench · Tentative
roster.what: Into the roster with class and spec, onto the bench or tentative.

state.t: Every player has exactly one state per squad. It stays until somebody changes it, even for weeks.

questions.t: Every squad has its own questions. They show up for everybody in its preselection.

history.t: Each player shows who changed their state, interview and votes, and when.

internal.t: Wishes, answers, votes and comments are only seen by those who may open the roster planner.

settings.title: Squad settings
settings.createHint: You lead the new squad. Add more leads in the settings afterwards.
settings.leadsHint: The leads hold the interviews and vote in the provisional roster.
settings.attendanceHint: Only the picked categories count, added up over their last raid nights. Without a pick the squad shows "—" everywhere.
settings.deleteText: All {n} players of this squad go with it, with their interviews, votes, comments and the example setups. The accounts' character data stays.

source.otherVersion: From the profile of another game version ({version})
source.tip: Where the character comes from: profile, logs or entered in the planner

pool.none: Nobody matches the search and filters.
pool.emptyKader: Nobody in this squad yet. Take players from a Discord role.
pool.removeText: With their interviews, votes and comments in this squad. The accounts' character data stays.
pool.nothingToMove: None of the marked players is in a state that allows this.

import.title: Add from a Discord role
import.noRoles: No roles known. Is the bot running, and may it read the member list?
import.rolesHint: Everybody with at least one chosen role shows up on the right. Whoever is in this squad already stays as they are.
import.pickRoles: Pick one or more roles on the left.
import.offline: The member list is not available right now (bot offline or without the members intent). Single players can be added by Discord ID.
import.summary: {n} will be taken, {missing} of them without character data.

add.title: Add a player
add.noMembers: No member list available. Add the player by Discord ID.
add.discordIdHint: In Discord: turn on developer mode, right-click the account, "Copy User ID".
add.charOptional: Character · optional, can be done later

interview.pick: Pick a player on the left.
interview.empty: Put players into the preselection in the pool, then hold the interviews here.
interview.locked: Completed. Reopen the interview to change it; who completed it when is in the history.
interview.noWishesYet: No wish yet. Add class and spec below.
interview.noQuestions: This squad has no questions of its own yet.
interview.listEmptyLead: No one here for this pick.

overview.openText: They still go into the provisional roster; the interview stays visible there.

decide.pickHint: Click a card: wishes, interview, votes, comments and the decision.
decide.decisionAria: Class and spec in the roster
decide.cantMove: This move is not possible directly.

history.migrated: taken over from the old roster planner ({to})
history.roleRemovedDiscord: Lost the role in Discord: {from} → Provisional
history.roleAddedDiscord: Got the role in Discord: {from} → Provisional
history.roleAddedDiscordNew: Got the role in Discord, new as provisional

questions.title: This squad's questions
questions.fixedText: Wishes in order · notes from the interview
questions.note: Applies to all {n} in this squad's preselection. A new question shows as open for everybody, a deleted one takes its answers along.
questions.colorHint: Every option has a colour, so it is recognised in the interview and the overview without reading. The dot on the left changes it.
questions.colorHintDays: Weekdays keep their fixed colours, as in the raider profile.
questions.renameHint: Renaming keeps the answers, removing takes them along.
questions.required: Required: an interview can only be completed once it is answered
questions.loseText: Answers to removed options or to another kind of answer are lost.
questions.copyHint: The questions are copied and added at the end, without answers.
questions.tooMany: Together that would be more than {max} questions.

setups.kicker: To play through in the meeting
setups.title: Example setups
setups.textHint: Copying did not work automatically. Select the text and copy it.
setups.hint: An example setup never changes a state. Pick which wished spec applies at the slot.
setups.pickHint: Now click a slot. Whoever sits there swaps.
setups.autoText: The current placement of this variant is replaced.
setups.hiddenGroups: The hidden groups are kept and show again in a larger setup.

account.onlyPlanner: Only applies in the roster planner and all its squads, the profile stays unchanged
account.resetText: The roster planner then shows the characters from the profile again.
account.removeText: The account disappears from every squad, with its interviews, votes and comments.
account.nameRule: First and last name, 2 to 12 letters each.
account.nickRule: 2 to 24 characters: letters, digits, space, hyphen, apostrophe.
account.noTank: This class has no tank spec
account.noHeal: This class has no healing spec
account.removeCharText: The character leaves the planner; it is only saved with Apply.
account.noChars: This account has no character yet. Add one above.
account.noProfile: This account has no EventHelper profile yet. Everything here is entered in the roster planner.
account.differs: Differs from the profile: {what}. The roster planner's assignment applies here, the profile is never overwritten.
account.differsNone: If your assignment differs from the profile, a note shows up here; nothing is overwritten.

att.noneSub: Pick the raid categories that count in the head of the attendance column or in the squad's settings.
att.noneSubRead: The leads pick the raid categories that count in the squad's settings.
att.notCountedSub: {cats} counted no night for this player yet.
att.pickLong: Pick the raid categories attendance counts in
att.menuHint: Applies to the whole squad: pool, provisional roster, player dialog and "Auto-assign".
att.noCategories: This server has no raid category yet. One shows up as soon as a raid is created in a Discord category.

sort.charSub: by class, then spec; no character data last
sort.rolesSub: by number of Discord roles, then name
sort.attendanceSub: by percent over the picked raid categories; "—" last
sort.stateSub: by state: pool, preselection, provisional, roster, bench, tentative
sort.wishSub: by role (tank, healer, melee, ranged), then class and spec
sort.interviewSub: open, started, held; then by progress
sort.prefillSub: by class, then spec; no character data last
sort.sourceSub: manual, profile, logs, already in the squad; missing last

answer.single: in the order of the options; unanswered last
answer.multi: by number of picked options; unanswered last

live.question: {by} changed the question “{text}”
live.plan_applied: {by} took over the draft plan for {who} as decisions
live.takeover: {by} took the Kader over (role, roster, channels)
live.role_removed_kader: {who} is no longer provisional or above: {by} removed role and roster
live.role_removed_discord: {who} lost the role in Discord and is provisional again
live.role_added_discord: {who} got the role in Discord and is provisional now

presence.interviewEdit: {name} is editing this interview right now
presence.interviewView: {name} is looking at this interview right now
presence.alsoInterviewEdit: {name} is editing this interview too right now
presence.accountEdit: {name} is editing the characters right now
presence.accountView: {name} is looking at the characters right now
presence.alsoAccountEdit: {name} is editing these characters too right now
presence.drawerView: {name} is looking at the discussion right now
presence.others: Also in the squad right now

conflict.interview: {name} has changed this interview in the meantime.
conflict.account: {name} has changed the characters in the meantime.
conflict.question: {name} has changed this question in the meantime.
conflict.hint: Your input is still here. “Reload” takes the new version, “Save anyway” overwrites it with yours.
conflict.lost: Your changes to the interview with {name} were not saved: it was changed in the meantime.

live.changed: {name} has changed this in the meantime. Saving makes your version count.

log.historyTip: History of {name}: who changed what and when
log.activityTip: Activity in the squad: who changed what recently
log.activityHint: The last 50 changes in this squad, newest first. Answers, notes and comments never show here.

composition.title: Composition
composition.specSub: The decision, else the first wish, else the prefilled character
composition.extraTip: Off: only provisional and roster count. Bench and tentative still show greyed out in the list.
composition.noSpecTip: Not counted in the roles until a decision or a wish is set.
composition.targetTip: From the game version's rule set, for the nearest setup size
composition.noBuffs: The rule set knows no buffs.
composition.empty: Nobody in provisional or roster yet. Players get here through the interviews.

plan.title: Draft plan
plan.note: changes no status until it is taken over
plan.noteTip: One shared draft per squad. Everyone with write access to the squad planner sees and edits it live.
plan.noDiff: changes no roles and no buffs
plan.excludeTip: Not counted in the draft. The status stays.
plan.discardText: The draft is deleted for everyone. Decisions and statuses stay as they are.
plan.applyTitle: Take the draft over as decisions?

applyText.one: {count} decision will be set, the status stays.
applyText.other: {count} decisions will be set, the status stays.

applyExcluded.one: {count} left-out player stays as they are.
applyExcluded.other: {count} left-out players stay as they are.

plan.applyNone: No planned spec differs from the decision.
plan.stale: Someone changed the draft in the meantime. Please take another look.

takeover.entryTip: Take the Kader over to Discord
takeover.entryTipSub: Create role, category and channels, hand the role to everybody from provisional up

title.role: Which role does the Kader get?

role.name: Role name
role.iconPick: Pick an emoji as role icon
role.iconHint: Shown in Discord next to the name.
role.iconOff: Role icons need boost level 2 – this server is at level {tier}.
role.becomes: The role becomes the roster role of “{roster}”.

replaces.one: It replaces {count} former roster role; that one stays in Discord.
replaces.other: It replaces {count} former roster roles; those stay in Discord.

channels.noCategories: The server has no category yet.
channels.existingHint: The channels go into this category; its permissions stay as they are.
channels.name: Name of channel {n}
channels.orgaOnlyTip: The role reads along, only the orga writes.
channels.who: Only the new role and the orga can see the channels.

who.core: Everybody becomes core in the roster – bench and tentative too.

outside.one: {count} roster member is not in the Kader and stays in the roster.
outside.other: {count} roster members are not in the Kader and stay in the roster.

away.one: {count} player is not on the server and gets the role later.
away.other: {count} players are not on the server and get the role later.

made.one: To be created: @{role}, category “{category}” and {count} channel.
made.other: To be created: @{role}, category “{category}” and {count} channels.

inRoster.one: {count} player is already in the roster and becomes core there.
inRoster.other: {count} players are already in the roster and become core there.

who.confirm: I checked the list – release the takeover
who.confirmTip: Only then can the takeover start.

result.iconNotPossible: icon not possible on this server
result.notRecorded: The takeover was not saved. Please reload the page and check the result.
result.missingHint: Whoever joins the server later gets the role via “Pull role” in the Kader head.

takeover.progress: {given} of {total} planned players have the role
takeover.lineAwayTip: Still without the role because they are not on the Discord server. Once they join, “Pull role” counts them.
takeover.roleGone: This role no longer exists in Discord.
takeover.pullTip: Give the role to everybody from provisional up who does not have it yet

pullText.one: {count} player gets the role and becomes core in the roster.
pullText.other: {count} players get the role and become core in the roster.

blocker.already_taken: This Kader was already taken over.
blocker.no_roster: The Kader is not linked to a roster – link it under “Roster” first.
blocker.no_players: Nobody in the Kader is provisional or further.
blocker.no_rights: Only someone who may edit the roster can take over.
blocker.offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now.
blocker.no_manage_roles: The bot lacks the permission “Manage Roles”.
blocker.no_manage_channels: The bot lacks the permission “Manage Channels”.

problem.role_emoji: Only a single emoji works as icon.
problem.category: The category needs a name or a choice.
problem.category_emoji: Only a single emoji works before the category.
problem.channel_name: Every channel needs a name of letters or digits.
problem.channel_emoji: Only a single emoji works before a channel.

error.stale: Someone changed the Kader in the meantime. The list is reloaded – please check it and release again.
error.already_taken: This Kader was already taken over.
error.no_players: Nobody in the Kader is provisional or further.
error.no_roster: The Kader is not linked to a roster.
error.offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now.
error.no_manage_roles: The bot lacks the permission “Manage Roles”.
error.no_manage_channels: The bot lacks the permission “Manage Channels”.
error.invalid_role: That role name does not work.
error.invalid_category: That category does not exist (any more).
error.invalid_channel: A channel name does not work.
error.role_failed: Discord did not create the role.
error.role_too_high: The new role would sit above the bot's role – move the bot's role up in Discord.
error.not_manager: Only someone who may edit the roster can take over.
error.running: The role is already being handed out.
error.not_taken: This Kader has not been taken over yet.
error.role_gone: The role no longer exists in Discord.
